about_the_game:
Regarding Live Commentary and Streaming
Live streaming and broadcasting are permitted throughout the entire game. Monetization is also allowed.
You may freely use screenshots for thumbnails and other purposes up until the point where the ending branches diverge. (After the branching point, thumbnail use is prohibited to avoid spoilers.)
Please include a link to the store page in your video description.
Do not include the contents of the DLC artbook in your videos.
summary
One day, a boy named “Shiomi” suddenly appears and the main character recognizes him as an imaginary friend that only he can see.
Shiomi is kind to him, preparing games and feeding him cake, but he is also somewhat suspicious, for example, he stops him from going out of the room. ......
This is a short visual novel game of about 30 minutes in which you play and talk with Shiomi and find out what happened to the main character.
game system
The game progresses by reading a conversation with Shiomi and choosing one of two options that occasionally appear during the conversation.
There are two endings.
Please see how the two of you end up together.
※Contains depictions of bloodshed.
credits

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains partial depictions of blood, mild violence, and indirect portrayal of suicide.
